originalTitle: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is probing nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles after receiving complaints about a suspension failure that could cause "a loss of vehicle directional control," as reported earlier by Reuters. content: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is probing nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles after receiving complaints about a suspension failure that could cause “a loss of vehicle directional control,” as reported earlier by Reuters. The preliminary investigation includes the 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2021-2023 Model Y, according to a filing from the NHTSA’s Office of Defects Investigation. The NHTSA says it received 156 complaints about the issue, which “involves the detachment of the front lower lateral link.” In most cases reviewed by the NHTSA, failure occurred with “no advance warning,” but some “cite noises occurring prior to failure.” The NHTSA hasn’t recorded any crashes, injuries, or fatalities related to the potential issue. This isn’t the first time Tesla dealt with suspension issues. In 2021, Tesla recalled 2,791 Model Y and Model 3 vehicles over a potential suspension defect. It later recalled another round of Model 3 vehicles after the NHTSA found that a “loose fastener could cause the lateral link to separate from the sub-frame.” The NHTSA says the complaints linked to its current investigation don’t appear to be related to these issues.
chineseTitle: NHTSA 正在调查 120 万辆特斯拉汽车的悬架故障报告
chineseSummary: 据路透社早些时候报道，美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 在收到有关悬架故障可能导致“车辆失去方向控制”的投诉后，正在对近 120 万辆特斯拉汽车进行调查。根据 NHTSA 办公室的一份文件，初步调查包括 2018-2020 年 Model 3 和 2021-2023 年 Model Y […]
chineseContent: 据路透社早些时候报道，美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 在收到有关悬架故障可能导致“车辆失去方向控制”的投诉后，正在对近 120 万辆特斯拉汽车进行调查。根据 NHTSA 缺陷调查办公室的文件，初步调查包括 2018-2020 年款 Model 3 和 2021-2023 年款 Model Y。 NHTSA 表示已收到 156 起有关该问题的投诉，其中“涉及前下侧连杆的脱离”。在美国国家公路交通安全管理局审查的大多数案例中，故障发生时“没有预先警告”，但有些“引用故障前发生的噪音”。 NHTSA 尚未记录任何与潜在问题相关的撞车、受伤或死亡事件。这并不是特斯拉第一次处理悬架问题。 2021 年，特斯拉因潜在的悬架缺陷召回了 2,791 辆 Model Y 和 Model 3 车辆。在 NHTSA 发现“松动的紧固件可能导致侧连杆与副车架分离”后，该公司又召回了另一轮 Model 3 车辆。美国国家公路交通安全管理局表示，与其当前调查相关的投诉似乎与这些问题无关。
